app.title: cash-scout
app.tagline: Plan, project forward, control and analyse your money.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.stayHint: For 30 days on this device. Leave it unticked on a shared computer.
signIn.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask the person who manages cash-scout to set a new one.

books.title: Books
books.empty: You are not a member of any book yet. Create one to start.
books.name: Name
books.currencyHint: Currency of the book's totals. It cannot be changed later.
books.defaultLanguageHint: Language of the categories when no translation exists.

book.deleteConfirm: Delete the book {name} and all its data? This cannot be undone.
book.languagesHint: Categories and accounts get a name in each of these languages.
book.noOtherUser: No other user. The super user creates users on the Users page.

admin.title: Users
admin.intro: As super user, you create the users. You see a book's data only if you are a member of it.
admin.name: Name
admin.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Give it to the user, who can change it later.
admin.removeConfirm: Remove the user {email}? Their memberships are removed too.
admin.forbidden: Only the super user can manage users.

reference.inUse: Cannot delete, still used by: {list}. You can archive it.

usedBy.balances: {count, plural, one {# analytic balance} other {# analytic balances}}
usedBy.budgets: {count, plural, one {# yearly budget} other {# yearly budgets}}
usedBy.budgetMonths: {count, plural, one {# reconciled budget month} other {# reconciled budget months}}
usedBy.statements: {count, plural, one {# imported statement} other {# imported statements}}

reference.name: Name
reference.colorHint: Shown on the group in the dashboard. A group with no colour takes its parent's.
reference.parentGroupHint: Leave empty for a top-level group. Groups nest to any depth, for example Assets › Rennes.
reference.naturesIntro: Natures split the dashboard into sections (income, spending, exceptional…). A balance adds up the natures you choose. Natures and balances share one order, which is the dashboard's.
reference.transferHint: What this nature holds stays out of the dashboard; only its categories can be used by transfers.
reference.balanceNaturesHint: The balance is the sum of the amounts, as entered, of these natures.
reference.codeHint: Short code that sets the order, e.g. C01.
reference.directionHint: Decides whether amounts count as spending or income, whatever their sign.
reference.moveHint: Pick another category to move this sub-category.
reference.currencyHint: Entries on this account are in this currency. It cannot be changed later.
reference.thresholdHint: Warn when the projected balance goes below this amount. Leave empty for no warning.
reference.emptyCategories: No categories yet. Start with a group, such as Daily life, then add its categories.
reference.openingIntro: The opening balance is the part of the account's balance that no entry explains: what came before the first entry, and whatever is missing. It sits in no category and counts in no total or budget.
reference.bankBalanceHint: The opening balance is worked out so that the reconciled entries give this balance, whatever their date.
reference.openingAmountHint: The opening balance itself, as it will be saved.
reference.openingRateHint: 1 {from} = how many {to}. Required unless the account already has entries: its latest rate is used.

statements.kept: {count, plural, one {# line kept} other {# lines kept}}: the statement is in the list below.
statements.deleteConfirm: Delete the statement {name} and its lines? Entries already imported stay in the journal, but these lines will no longer be recognised as seen before.
statements.title: Import a bank statement
statements.intro: Choose the account, your bank's format and the exported CSV file. The file is read and shown here; nothing enters the journal before the review and the import.
statements.summary: {count, plural, one {# line read} other {# lines read}}, from {from} to {to}
statements.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved at this step.
statements.unreadable: {count, plural, one {# unreadable line, skipped} other {# unreadable lines, skipped}}
statements.breaks: {count, plural, one {# end-of-day balance does not add up} other {# end-of-day balances do not add up}}
statements.breaksHint: A day's balance should be the previous day's plus the day's lines. A line is missing or doubled around these dates.
statements.label: Label

review.selected: {count, plural, one {# line selected} other {# lines selected}}
review.opening: Set the opening balance to {proposed} instead of {current}
review.openingLater: The opening balance can be set once no line is left to review.
review.import: {count, plural, =0 {Set the opening balance} one {Import # line} other {Import # lines}}
review.importConfirm: {count, plural, =0 {Set the account's opening balance?} one {Write # line into the journal?} other {Write # lines into the journal?}}
review.done: Imported: {created, plural, one {# entry created} other {# entries created}}, {matched, plural, one {# entry reconciled} other {# entries reconciled}}.
review.undo: Undo the import of {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}
review.undoConfirm: Undo the import? Created entries are deleted, reconciled entries get their date and state back. The opening balance is not restored.
review.undone: Undone: {removed, plural, one {# entry deleted} other {# entries deleted}}, {restored, plural, one {# entry restored} other {# entries restored}}{skipped, plural, =0 {} one {, # left as it is (changed since)} other {, # left as they are (changed since)}}.
review.acceptRules: Accept the proposals of the rules ({count})
review.ruleIgnores: The rule "{name}" proposes to ignore this line
review.unmatched: {count, plural, one {# forecast of the period with no line} other {# forecasts of the period with no line}}
review.unmatchedHint: If a line of the statement is one of them, choose it on the line: otherwise the entry will be written twice.
review.suggestRule: "{text}" is filed under {subCategory}. A rule would do the same for the next statements.
review.suggestOthers: {count, plural, one {# other line to review of this statement fits} other {# other lines to review of this statement fit}}
review.transferTo: Transfer to {account} (the other side is left to reconcile)
review.transferFrom: Transfer from {account} (the other side is left to reconcile)

rules.title: Rules
rules.intro: A rule proposes a sub-category, a description or ignoring the statement lines that fit its conditions. Rules are tried in order: the first that fits wins. They are only proposals, to accept in the review.
rules.name: Name
rules.touches: {count, plural, =0 {No line to review of this statement fits} one {# line to review of this statement fits} other {# lines to review of this statement fit}}
rules.deleteConfirm: Delete the rule {name}? Its proposals to lines not yet accepted are taken back.

dashboard.selectHint: Select a cell to see its entries.

budget.title: Budget {year}
budget.changeHint: Income − spending − saving: what the plan does to the book's accounts. Not a target.
budget.problemAmount: The amount is not a valid number.
budget.problemRate: Give the exchange rate of this account's currency.
budget.locked: Reconciled month: take the reconciliation back in the journal to change it.
budget.leaveUnsaved: Some changes are not saved. Drop them?
budget.accountHint: The account this budget should be spent from: where what is still expected shows at the end of each month.
budget.problemAccount: Choose the account of this budget.

entries.copied: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to copy} one {# entry copied} other {# entries copied}}

budget.problemEntries: {count, plural, one {# entry to fix} other {# entries to fix}}

transfers.count: {count, plural, =0 {No transfer} one {# transfer} other {# transfers}}
transfers.copied: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to copy} one {# transfer copied} other {# transfers copied}}
transfers.skipped: {count, plural, one {# transfer between currencies left unchanged} other {# transfers between currencies left unchanged}}
transfers.problem: {count, plural, one {# transfer to fix} other {# transfers to fix}}

journal.subCategoryHint: Its category decides whether the amount is spending or income.
journal.amountHint: Signed, as on the bank statement: -12.50 for a payment.
journal.exchangeRateHint: 1 {from} = how many {to}. Kept when saved, so past totals do not move.
journal.reconciledHint: Matched with the bank statement. An entry not reconciled is a forecast.
journal.needsReference: Add an account and a sub-category in the reference data before entering transactions.

invalid.amount: Enter an amount with at most the currency's decimals, e.g. -12.50.
invalid.exchangeRate: Enter a rate above zero, e.g. 0.2.
invalid.originalAmount: Enter an amount in the original currency.
invalid.originalCurrency: Pick the currency of the original amount.

journal.truncated: Showing the latest {shown} of {total} entries. Pick a year or search to see older ones.
journal.frequentHint: Most used in 12 months, dated today
journal.uses: {count, plural, one {Used once} other {Used # times}} in 12 months
journal.monthEndHint: Computed from the category's grid, less the month's unplanned entries, on the budget's account. It cannot be edited; reconcile it to let the rest go.
journal.chartAllAccounts: All accounts. Only the account filter acts here, not the period, category, status or search.
journal.chartOneAccount: The selected account. Only the account filter acts here, not the period, category, status or search.
journal.overdraftFrom: is overdrawn from {from}, to the end of the chart (lowest {lowest} on {lowestDate}).
journal.overdue: {count, plural, one {# past entry is not reconciled.} other {# past entries are not reconciled.}}
journal.newMenu: New split, transfer, compensation or frequent entry

password.resetIntro: For {email}. Give them the new password; they can change it after signing in. Their open sessions end.
password.resetDone: New password saved for {email}. Their open sessions have ended.
password.changeHint: You stay signed in here; your other devices are signed out.
password.changeFailed: The current password is wrong, or the new one is not accepted.

transfer.dateHint: The day it leaves the source account.
transfer.delayHint: Days before it reaches the destination.
transfer.amountHint: Positive: the amount that leaves the source account.
transfer.destinationAmountHint: The accounts are in different currencies: the amount that arrives.
transfer.subCategoryHint: Only the categories of the transfer direction, which are left out of the totals.
transfer.noCategory: Add a category of the transfer direction, with a sub-category, in the reference data first.
transfer.reconcileHint: Each side is reconciled on its own, with its own bank statement line. Changing the transfer changes both sides.
transfer.deleteConfirm: Delete this transfer and both of its entries?

invalid.delayDays: Enter a whole number of days, 0 to 60.
invalid.destinationAccountId: Pick a destination account, different from the source.
invalid.amount: Enter a positive amount with at most the currency's decimals.
invalid.sourceRate: Enter a rate above zero, e.g. 0.2.
invalid.destinationRate: Enter a rate above zero, e.g. 0.2.

compensation.deleteConfirm: Delete this compensation and both of its lines?

invalid.minusSubCategoryId: Pick a sub-category, different from the first.
invalid.amount: Enter a positive amount with at most the currency's decimals.

split.deleteConfirm: Delete this split and all its parts?
split.invalid: Fill in the date, account, bank amount and every part.
